QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_51

question.text: In the Niwas case, PMAY beneficiary enrolment by the SE is reported at 23%. The SIA should verify this by:

answer.text: Checking the SE's own claim only
Reviewing PMAY data and documents as part of the desk review and sampling beneficiary records for consistency with project documentation

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook supports a desk review of data on Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana and sampling beneficiary records for consistency with project documentation. The Niwas case lists PMAY beneficiary enrolment at 23%. The Trap: SE-only claims, tweets and media articles are uncorroborated and not sufficient appropriate evidence. Note: Document the desk review of PMAY data and the sample of beneficiary records examined in the working papers.
